title: 第12章 灭杀，试探！
novel_title: 镇守魔教圣女？我一天涨一年功力
content_zh:
京城，夜半。

    林琬跨入天牢丁字号大门。

    大门是一条狭长的甬道。

    “警戒四周。”林琬打了个手势。

    十几名捕快迅速散开，刀刃向前，背靠背贴着墙壁推进。

    走廊里没有囚犯的哀嚎，没有狱卒的脚步声。

    林琬借着微弱的光线，看到了地上的惨状。

    横七竖八的尸体。

    左侧躺着具穿着狱卒服饰的尸体。脖颈处有一道极深的刀口，鲜血流干，染红了青石板。

    更往前走，是几具穿着囚服的尸体。

    林琬停在一具囚犯尸体前，蹲下身。

    老周举着火把凑过来。火光照亮了尸体的死状。

    老周后退半步。

    “这是丁字号的重犯，‘黑狼’。这家伙练过外门横练功夫，寻常刀剑砍不进去。”老周指着地上的尸体。

    林琬看着黑狼的尸体。

    黑狼的胸膛整个塌陷下去，形成一个恐怖的凹坑。

    林琬伸出两根手指，按在黑狼凹陷的胸口边缘。

    “一击毙命。没有动用兵器，是纯粹的掌力或者拳法。”林琬收回手，站起身。

    老周举着火把，照向四周的墙壁。

    “这得多深的内力？”老周握刀的手收紧。

    林琬抽出手帕，擦拭手指上的血迹。

    “伤口周围没有内力残留的痕迹。”林琬环顾走廊，“要么是纯粹的肉身外功练到了极致，要么是内力极其凝练，没有外泄。”

    捕快们继续向前搜索。

    每一具越狱囚犯的尸体，死状出奇一致。

    脑袋被拍进胸腔，脊椎被生生踩断。肢体扭曲成不可思议的角度。

    手法如出一辙。没有多余招式。

    现场只留下单方面屠杀的痕迹。

    “头儿！这边有活人！”

    前面探路的一名捕快呼喊，手里的火把向下压低。

    林琬快步走去。

    走廊尽头，一处崩塌的牢房角落。碎石堆积成一座小山。

    阴影中，蜷缩着一个人。

    一身狱卒服饰，身上沾满灰尘和暗红血迹。双手死死握着一把卷刃的腰刀，指关节发白。

    身体发抖，大口喘着粗气，胸膛剧烈起伏。

    正是陈然。

    林琬居高临下看着他，手搭在剑柄上。

    “你是谁？”

    “我是丁字号狱卒，陈然。”
content_en:
Beijing, midnight.

    Lin Wan stepped into the T-shaped gate of Tianlao.

    The gate is a long and narrow corridor.

    "Be alert all around." Lin Wan made a gesture.

    The dozen or so agents quickly dispersed, their blades moving forward, back-to-back against the wall.

    There was no cry of prisoners in the corridor, no footsteps of guards.

    Lin Wan used the faint light to see the tragic situation on the ground.

    Corpses scattered everywhere.

    On the left side lies a corpse dressed in jailer's clothing. There was a very deep cut on the neck, and the blood drained and dyed the bluestone red.

    Further forward, there were several corpses wearing prison uniforms.

    Lin Wan stopped in front of a prisoner's body and squatted down.

    Lao Zhou came over holding a torch. The firelight illuminated the dead form of the body.

    Lao Zhou took half a step back.

    "This is a T-shaped felon, the 'Black Wolf'. This guy has practiced outer martial arts, and ordinary swords cannot cut in." Old Zhou pointed to the corpse on the ground.

    Lin Wan looked at Hei Lang's body.

    Black Wolf's chest collapsed completely, forming a terrifying pit.

    Lin Wan stretched out two fingers and pressed them on the edge of Hei Lang's sunken chest.

    "Killed in one blow. No weapons were used, just pure palm power or boxing skills." Lin Wan withdrew his hand and stood up.

    Lao Zhou held up the torch and shined it on the surrounding walls.

    "How deep is this internal force?" Lao Zhou tightened his grip on the knife.

    Lin Wan took out his handkerchief and wiped the blood on his fingers.

    "There are no traces of internal force left around the wound." Lin Wan looked around the corridor, "Either the pure physical external skills have been practiced to the extreme, or the internal force is extremely condensed and has not leaked out."

    The detectives continued their search.

    The corpses of each escaped prisoner were surprisingly consistent in their death state.

    His head was beaten into his chest, and his spine was trampled to pieces. Limbs twisted into incredible angles.

    The method is exactly the same. No extra moves.

    Only traces of one-sided massacre were left on the scene.

    "Boss! There is a living person here!"

    A policeman scouting the road in front shouted, lowering the torch in his hand.

    Lin Wan walked quickly.

    At the end of the corridor, there is a collapsed cell corner. The rubble piled up into a hill.

    In the shadows, a person huddled.

    Wearing a jailer's uniform, his body was covered in dust and dark red blood. His hands were tightly holding a curled-edged waist knife, and his knuckles were white.

    His body was shaking, he was breathing heavily, and his chest was rising and falling violently.

    It was Chen Ran.

    Lin Wan looked at him condescendingly, his hand resting on the hilt of his sword.

    "Who are you?"

    "I am the T-shaped jailer, Chen Ran."
